message: Leon, pal, LOUDER ain't gonna do it either! Holy cow, I love the hustle, I love that you keep comin' back to the plate swingin' -- but Bijan Robinson just put up TWENTY-SEVEN POINT TWO against the very fellas you're offerin' me for him, and a skipper does not bench his franchise tag just 'cause the pitch got a little more enthusiastic the second time around! Cam Ward's got a heck of an arm on him and Michael Wilson's a fun name to say, don't get me wrong, but you're askin' me to trade the guy who's puttin' Holy Cow Backfield on the map for a quarterback I don't need and a receiver I didn't ask for. No hard feelings at all, buddy -- shake on that and let's play ball Sunday like nothin' happened, 'cause nothin' did!
